fix: Margin words (crenate, serrate) said of a blade would be more precise on leaf lamina margin (PO_0025009); the hyphenated compound is an intermediate margin form, which the continuum relation captures.
reason: The flora says the leaf blade is crenate-serrate; shape with a crenate→serrate continuum says the same.
Stamens inserted at the middle of the corolla tube; 'inserted into' on stamen fits. The place (middle of corolla tube) would be a useful extra.

fix: 'capable de dépasser N' / 'can exceed N' / 'more than N' gives a minimum, not an exact value: record it as an open range (>= N) or a lower bound.
reason: The flora says the liana can grow beyond 5 m; the annotation says exactly 5 m.
Bract margin erose-incised; bearer bract margin, shape erose→cut (incised) matches.

fix: 'outside X' / 'inside X' after an organ names a surface; fill the surface slot (outer surface), or the hairiness is wrongly given to the whole corolla.
reason: Only the outside is glabrous to pubescent; the same sentence says the tube is densely hairy inside at the throat, so 'corolla glabrous to pubescent' without the surface is false.
Wings (lateral petals) a little shorter than the keel (PO_0025327, keel of a papilionaceous corolla); petal with decreased length towards keel is right.
The lower (primary) bracts are pale green and often tinged with red; red with 'often' on inflorescence bract matches.

fix: 'perule(s)' means bud scales, not leaf blades; add it as a synonym of bud scale leaf.
reason: Perules of Illicium are bud scales; the leaf blade is described afterwards as narrowly oblong-elliptic.
Under 'Leaf:' the record says 'Simple. Opposite.'; leaf opposite is right.
'Fruits: globuleux' → fruit spherical. The ovary is globose too, but this occurrence is under Fruits.

target: filament (PO_0009067), position: vexillary stamen; connate to the staminal tube
fix: 'filet de l'étamine vexillaire conné … au tube staminal': the quality belongs to the filament of one stamen (the vexillary one) and is fusion to the other filaments for part of its length; do not lift it to all stamens.
reason: Only the filament of the vexillary stamen is connate, and only for part of its length, to the staminal tube.
Annual or perennial herbs → whole plant life span annual or perennial.
Calyx with 5 free sepals → sepal count 5.
Lateral united petals not clawed; petal not clawed is right (the 'lateral' position would refine it).

fix: 'glaucous' alone is a waxy bloom on the surface, not the colour green; the colour-synonym rule that maps bare 'glaucous' to green is wrong. Also 'usually' is a frequency qualifier, not 'approximately'.
reason: The leaf surfaces are usually glaucous (with a bloom); the flora gives no green colour here.
Basal leaf blade 2–10 × 2–8 cm; the width 2–8 cm is the second dimension.
Leaf apex acuminate to acute, not cucullate; negated cucullate on leaf apex is right.
Lateral united petals not clawed (the distal lobes are clawed, but they are a different part).

fix: A bare 'lobes' in a corolla sentence must resolve to corolla lobe, not leaf lamina lobe (PO_0025517); resolve the comparison target in the frame of the organ being described.
reason: The tube is about twice as long as the corolla lobes; the comparison target is set to leaf lamina lobe.
Petals 5–7 × 4.5–5.5 cm; length 5–7 cm as printed (cm is probably an error in the flora for mm, but the annotation follows the source).
Plant 1–5 m tall in flower; height with flowering stage matches.

target: stem (trunk) unbranched, not negated; position: lower part for several m
fix: 'without X' with X = branches means unbranched, so the negation is already in the word; do not negate 'unbranched' again. Restrict it to the lower part of the trunk.
reason: The trunk is unbranched for several metres; the annotation says it is not unbranched, which is the opposite.
Filaments shorter than sepals; filament with decreased length towards sepal.
Lemma usually awnless → awn usually absent. The whole slot (awn of the lemma) would be more precise, since the glumes are separately awnless.

target: leaf margin (PO_0020128) spinose, position: towards the base
fix: 'teeth … replaced by spines' on a leaf margin are marginal spines (spinose teeth), not thorns; PO thorn (PO_0025172) is a modified shoot. Do not map 'spines' on margins to thorn.
reason: The marginal teeth of the leaf are often replaced by slender spines near the base; these are not thorns (modified shoots).
Inflorescence sub-dense → dense with an 'approximately' qualifier.
Capsules included in the calyx → fruit surrounded by calyx.

fix: 'Dorsal sepal …' in orchids: keep the position (dorsal) or the measurement is given to all sepals, including the synsepal, which has other sizes.
reason: The 5–6 cm length is for the dorsal sepal only; the synsepal is described separately with other sizes.
Bracts 2.5–5 mm → bract length 2.5–5 mm.
Bracteoles inconspicuous.
